name: Billing platform modernisation
description: A client is moving its customer billing from one large legacy application to services. The team is mid-project, deadlines are tight, and the client wants someone who stays calm and accountable when things slip.
expectations: Owns problems and tells the client early when a date will slip
Gives specific dates, costs and names instead of general reassurance
Stays composed under pressure and keeps the delivery moving
Can explain the technical choices well enough for a client to trust them
